text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, Gran Alegria and Verxina headed to a trending spot—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this is it, right here!
The place with the super accurate fortune teller!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"So this is it! Ooh, I wonder how it'll turn out.
I'm so excited, fifty miles!"

text_block_list.name: Fortune Teller
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, starting with you... Huh, wha—!?
—GYAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah!? Are you okay!!?
You completely flipped over!

text_block_list.name: Fortune Teller
text_block_list.text:
Ooooooh, please calm down and listen to me...!
--Your fortune for tomorrow is CRAZY bad!!
So bad it's got me completely flipped out!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: What?! Th-That much?

text_block_list.name: Fortune Teller
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Pay close attention to everything around you!
And avoid going outside as much as possible!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Morning, Gran! ...Hey, you doing okay?
After what they said to you yesterday and all.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, so far so good!
Nothing in particular ha—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: —Teyaaa!!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Wah!?
What's wrong all of a sudden!?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I saw bird poop falling, so I scrambled to dodge it! Danger level: 40 miles per hour!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, I see.
Today was really..."

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Verxina-senpai!
Good mor-mile!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Oh. Good afternoon, Gran-san.
Having salad today too?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"No, it's soba!
—I love soba too! Did you know?
Fukushima's soba is super delicious!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I ate it when I went to Fukushima during my time off, and I just couldn't forget it! Ever since, I've been hooked on soba!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Is that so?
...Oh? But if I recall, today's soba was—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? It's true!
It says soba sales are suspended!?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: All right! Got it!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry... It's all my fault...
Going so far as to climb a tree for the ball...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"No, I'm fine! I mean, it's me!
This much is—"

text_block_list.name: Bee
text_block_list.text:
(...Vroom. Vroom...
Vroom vroom vroom vroom!!!)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
…………Ah. Could it be……
did I stir up a hornet's nest……?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: R-Ruuuuun!!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
And so, by smoothly dodging the entire swarm of bees,
I've made it right here in one piece!
choice_data_list: I see. Sounds like you had a terrible day...
I see. Sounds like you had a rough day...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? Why is that?"
choice_data_list: What do you mean why...? It seemed like nothing went right for you the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! A lot of things happened, sure—
but nothing I'd ever call misfortune, not at all!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...Because 'a day different from usual'
is just, like, super exciting the whole time!!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I wasn't bored in the slightest!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yes! After the poop dropped on me, my heart was racing thinking, "Could there be a next time!?"—

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Running from bees feels just like an amusement park ride!
I think having something like this in a theme park would be awesome!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then! The udon I had instead
of soba was suuuper delicious too!
What a pleasant surprise!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...When the fortune teller told me that, I thought to myself—I am definitely not going to lose!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Total victory achieved♪
Peace peace!
choice_data_list: ...You really are tough at heart, aren't you?
...You really are tough at heart, aren't you?
You're really good at bouncing back quickly!
You're really good at bouncing back quickly!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Total victory achieved♪
Peace peace!
choice_data_list: ...You really are tough at heart, aren't you?
...You really are tough at heart, aren't you?
You're really good at bouncing back quickly!
You're really good at bouncing back quickly!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: “Naturally! After all, I am destined to become the true Mile Queen—”

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: It has to be, right? ☆

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Um... yes!
That's true, but...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Rather than being good at bouncing back,
maybe I just never got down in the first place!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Because I'm not the type to get discouraged
by something like this! Ehehe."
